profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a commercial-stage company that develops autonomous driving technology, according to its website. It describes itself as a global company working on driving automation from Level 2 to Level 4, and says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries. The company is headquartered in Guangzhou and is publicly listed, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800.

The company points to the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. It says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi, and describes itself as a pioneer in large-scale commercial deployment of autonomous driving. The site also states that WeRide has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

Public records held for the company list it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001867729 and the alias WERIDE INC-ADR. No litigation is recorded against it.
